# Task P1-02: MusicBrainz client, request spacing and the metadata cache

**Phase:** 1 · **Depends on:** none · **Suggested tier:** cheap worker · **Estimated size:** M

## Goal
Compilarr can ask MusicBrainz (WS/2, JSON) for recordings by artist + title, by MBID and by ISRC, list every official release a recording appears on, and read one release's tracklist — politely: at most one request per second across the whole process, a descriptive User-Agent, retries that honour `Retry-After`, and a SQLite-backed response cache with TTLs so repeat lookups cost nothing. This is the metadata plumbing the Deezer/iTunes/Cover Art clients (P1-04) reuse.

## Deliverables
Namespace `Compilarr.Core.Metadata` (sub-namespaces per folder). `sealed` classes, XML doc comments, `CancellationToken` on every async method.

1. `src/Compilarr.Core/Metadata/MetadataOptions.cs` — the `metadata` section of `config.yml` (keys are snake_case in YAML and `APP__METADATA__MUSICBRAINZ_BASE_URL` in the environment; the existing config sources strip underscores): `MusicBrainzBaseUrl` = `https://musicbrainz.org/ws/2/`, `CoverArtArchiveBaseUrl` = `https://coverartarchive.org/`, `DeezerBaseUrl` = `https://api.deezer.com/`, `ITunesBaseUrl` = `https://itunes.apple.com/`, `ContactUrl` = `https://github.com/wulfftech/compilarr`. A `MetadataOptionsValidator : IValidateOptions<MetadataOptions>` requires each URL to be absolute http(s); messages start with the YAML key (`metadata.musicbrainz_base_url: …`) like `ServerOptionsValidator`. Base URLs are normalised to end with `/`.
2. `src/Compilarr.Core/Metadata/Http/RequestSpacingGate.cs` — `public sealed class RequestSpacingGate(TimeSpan minInterval, TimeProvider timeProvider)` with `ValueTask WaitAsync(CancellationToken)`: reserves the next start slot under a lock (`slot = max(now, nextFree)`, `nextFree = slot + minInterval`), then `await Task.Delay(slot - now, timeProvider, ct)` when positive. So N concurrent callers start at t, t+1 s, t+2 s…
3. `src/Compilarr.Core/Metadata/Http/RequestSpacingHandler.cs` — `DelegatingHandler` that awaits its gate before `base.SendAsync`. Gates are **keyed singletons** (`AddKeyedSingleton<RequestSpacingGate>("musicbrainz", …)`) so every `HttpClient` the factory builds, and every handler rotation, shares one gate per host.
4. `src/Compilarr.Core/Metadata/MetadataCache.cs` — entity `MetadataCacheEntry : EntityBase` (table `metadata_cache`: `Provider`, `Key`, `Payload` (text), `FetchedAt`, `ExpiresAt`; unique index (`Provider`, `Key`), index on `ExpiresAt`) with an `IEntityTypeConfiguration<MetadataCacheEntry>`; `IMetadataCache` with `Task<string?> GetAsync(string provider, string key, CancellationToken)` (null when missing or expired), `Task SetAsync(string provider, string key, string payload, TimeSpan ttl, CancellationToken)` (upsert) and `Task<int> PurgeExpiredAsync(CancellationToken)`; `MetadataCache` is a **singleton** that opens a fresh scope (`IServiceScopeFactory`) and `CompilarrDbContext` per call, and upserts with one `INSERT … ON CONFLICT(provider, key) DO UPDATE SET …` statement (`ExecuteSqlInterpolatedAsync`, set `created_at`/`updated_at` yourself), so concurrent writers of the same key cannot collide. Times from `TimeProvider`.
5. `src/Compilarr.Core/Metadata/MusicBrainz/MusicBrainzModels.cs` — DTOs as `sealed record`s with `init` properties; collection properties default to `[]` so a missing JSON array reads as empty. JSON via `System.Text.Json` with `JsonNamingPolicy.KebabCaseLower` plus `[JsonPropertyName("joinphrase")]` on `MbArtistCredit.JoinPhrase`:
   - `MbArtist { Id, Name, SortName?, Disambiguation? }`, `MbArtistCredit { Name, JoinPhrase?, Artist }` with `static string Format(IReadOnlyList<MbArtistCredit>)` → `name + joinphrase` concatenated ("Daft Punk feat. Pharrell Williams");
   - `MbRecording { Id, Title, Length? (int, ms), Disambiguation?, Video, FirstReleaseDate?, Score? (int, search only), ArtistCredit, Isrcs, Releases }`;
   - `MbReleaseGroup { Id, Title, PrimaryType?, SecondaryTypes, FirstReleaseDate? }`;
   - `MbRelease { Id, Title, Status?, Date?, Country?, ArtistCredit, ReleaseGroup?, Media }`, `MbMedium { Position, Format?, TrackCount, Tracks }`, `MbTrack { Id, Position, Number?, Title?, Length?, Recording? (MbRecording with just Id/Title) }`;
   - `MbRecordingSearchResult { Count, Offset, Recordings }`, and the browse page `{ release-count, release-offset, releases }` (internal).
6. `src/Compilarr.Core/Metadata/MusicBrainz/MusicBrainzQuery.cs` — `static string Escape(string term)` (backslash-escape Lucene specials `+ - && || ! ( ) { } [ ] ^ " ~ * ? : \ /`), and `static string RecordingByArtistAndTitle(string artist, string title)` → `recording:"<title>" AND artist:"<artist>"` with both escaped (inside quotes only `"` and `\` strictly need it, but escaping all specials is fine: MB's own example turns `AC/DC` into `AC\/DC`).
7. `src/Compilarr.Core/Metadata/MusicBrainz/IMusicBrainzClient.cs` + `MusicBrainzClient.cs` (typed `HttpClient`):
   - `Task<MbRecordingSearchResult> SearchRecordingsAsync(string luceneQuery, int limit = 25, CancellationToken)` → `GET recording?query=<url-encoded>&limit=<1..100>&fmt=json`; cache TTL 1 day.
   - `Task<MbRecording?> GetRecordingAsync(string recordingId, CancellationToken)` → `GET recording/{id}?inc=artist-credits+isrcs&fmt=json`; TTL 7 days; 404 → null.
   - `Task<IReadOnlyList<MbRecording>> GetRecordingsByIsrcAsync(string isrc, CancellationToken)` → `GET isrc/{ISRC upper-cased}?inc=artist-credits&fmt=json`; TTL 7 days; 404 → empty. ISRC must match `^[A-Z]{2}[A-Z0-9]{3}\d{7}$` after upper-casing, else `ArgumentException`.
   - `Task<IReadOnlyList<MbRelease>> GetReleasesForRecordingAsync(string recordingId, int maxPages = 3, CancellationToken)` → browse `GET release?recording={id}&status=official&inc=release-groups+media+artist-credits&limit=100&offset={0,100,200}&fmt=json`, paging while `offset < release-count` and pages < `maxPages`; TTL 7 days per page. (Recording lookups cap `inc=releases` at 25 — that is why this is a browse.)
   - `Task<MbRelease?> GetReleaseAsync(string releaseId, CancellationToken)` → `GET release/{id}?inc=recordings+artist-credits+release-groups&fmt=json`; TTL 30 days; 404 → null.
   - MBIDs are validated with `Guid.TryParse` (and not `Guid.Empty`) before any request → `ArgumentException` (MB answers 400 to invalid ids). Ids are sent and returned lower-case.
   - Cache: provider `"musicbrainz"`, key = the relative request URI. A 200 body is cached with the TTL above; a 404 is cached as the payload `null` for 1 day; anything else non-2xx after retries throws `MetadataProviderException` (new, in `Compilarr.Core.Metadata`, carries `Provider` and `StatusCode`, message without any header or key values).
8. `src/Compilarr.Core/Metadata/MetadataServiceCollectionExtensions.cs` — `public static IServiceCollection AddCompilarrMetadata(this IServiceCollection services, IConfiguration configuration)`: binds + validates `MetadataOptions` (`ValidateOnStart`), registers `IMetadataCache` (singleton), the `"musicbrainz"` gate (1 s), and `AddHttpClient<IMusicBrainzClient, MusicBrainzClient>` with base address from options, `User-Agent: Compilarr/<version> ( <ContactUrl> )` (version = the entry assembly's informational version without the `+sha` suffix; add with `TryAddWithoutValidation`), `Accept: application/json`, then — in this order — `AddResilienceHandler("musicbrainz", …)` with a retry strategy (`HttpRetryStrategyOptions`: 3 retries, exponential backoff with jitter, `Delay` = `MetadataOptions.RetryBaseDelay` (internal settable, default 2 s, not bound from config), `ShouldRetryAfterHeader = true`; default `ShouldHandle` covers 5xx/408/429/transport errors) and **after it** `AddHttpMessageHandler` for the spacing handler, so every attempt including retries passes the gate. Call it from `src/Compilarr.Api/Program.cs` right after `AddCompilarrCore()`.
9. `CompilarrDbContext`: add `DbSet<MetadataCacheEntry> MetadataCache` and `modelBuilder.ApplyConfiguration(new MetadataCacheEntryConfiguration())`; migration `AddMetadataCache` generated with `dotnet tool restore` then `dotnet ef migrations add AddMetadataCache --project src/Compilarr.Core --startup-project src/Compilarr.Core --output-dir Persistence/Migrations` (never hand-written; delete any `design.db`).
10. Tests:
    - `tests/Compilarr.Sources.Tests/Metadata/MusicBrainzClientTests.cs` — contract tests: `MusicBrainzClient` built directly over an `HttpClient` with a stub `HttpMessageHandler` that serves files from `tests/fixtures/musicbrainz/` (add a `<None Include="..\..\tests\fixtures\musicbrainz\**\*.*" …>` item to the test csproj like the slskd one) and records request URIs; an in-memory `IMetadataCache` fake.
    - `tests/Compilarr.Sources.Tests/Metadata/RequestSpacingTests.cs` — the gate with `FakeTimeProvider`, and one DI composition test (below).
    - `tests/Compilarr.Sources.Tests/Metadata/MusicBrainzLiveTests.cs` + `LiveFactAttribute.cs` (a `FactAttribute` whose constructor sets `Skip` unless `COMPILARR_LIVE_TESTS=1`): through the real DI pipeline with the in-memory cache.
    - `tests/Compilarr.Core.Tests/Metadata/MetadataCacheTests.cs` — against real SQLite (`SqliteTestDatabase`).

## Constraints
- Packages already referenced: `Microsoft.Extensions.Http` 10.0.12, `Microsoft.Extensions.Http.Resilience` 10.10.0 (brings Polly 8), `Microsoft.Extensions.TimeProvider.Testing` 10.10.0 in the test projects. No new packages. Resilience API: `builder.AddResilienceHandler("musicbrainz", pipeline => pipeline.AddRetry(new HttpRetryStrategyOptions { MaxRetryAttempts = 3, BackoffType = DelayBackoffType.Exponential, UseJitter = true, Delay = …, ShouldRetryAfterHeader = true }))` (`using Microsoft.Extensions.Http.Resilience; using Polly;`).
- Never exceed 1 request/s to MusicBrainz, including in tests: contract tests use the stub handler, only `[LiveFact]` tests touch the network and they make at most 4 requests.
- `TimeProvider` for all time; no `DateTime.UtcNow`.
- Another task (P1-01) edits `CompilarrDbContext.cs` in parallel: keep your change there to the one `DbSet` line and the one `ApplyConfiguration` line.

## Acceptance criteria (each must be demonstrated)
1. `dotnet build -warnaserror` → 0 warnings, 0 errors; `dotnet test` → all pass, live tests reported as skipped (paste the summary lines).
2. Search: parsing `search-get-lucky.json` yields ≥ 8 recordings, the first with `Score` 100, `Length` 242213, artist credit "Daft Punk", and a recording whose `Disambiguation` is "Music Factory DJ Beats version with 8-bar intro and outro"; the request URI contains `query=recording%3A%22Get%20Lucky%22%20AND%20artist%3A%22Daft%20Punk%22` (or the `+`-for-space equivalent your encoder produces — assert on the decoded query) and `fmt=json`.
3. `MusicBrainzQuery.RecordingByArtistAndTitle("AC/DC", "Back in Black")` → `recording:"Back in Black" AND artist:"AC\/DC"`; a title containing a double quote is escaped.
4. Lookup: `GetRecordingAsync("B1A9C0E9-D987-4042-AE91-78D6A3267D69")` requests the lower-case id and returns length 355106 and 7 ISRCs; `recording-unknown.json` served with 404 → null, and a second call does not hit the handler (negative cache); `GetRecordingAsync("not-a-guid")` and the nil GUID throw `ArgumentException` without a request.
5. ISRC: `GetRecordingsByIsrcAsync("gbum71029604")` → one recording `b1a9c0e9-…` with artist "Queen"; unknown ISRC (404) → empty list; `"XX"` → `ArgumentException`.
6. Browse: with a stub that serves the p0 fixture for `offset=0` and records requests, `GetReleasesForRecordingAsync(id, maxPages: 3)` requests offsets 0, 100, 200 (and not 300); each release exposes `ReleaseGroup.PrimaryType`/`SecondaryTypes` (the first is an Album with secondary type "Compilation") and media with `TrackCount` and empty `Tracks`.
7. Release: `GetReleaseAsync("6defd963-fe91-4550-b18e-82c685603c2b")` → the track whose recording id is `b1a9c0e9-…` has medium position 1, track position 11, number "B4".
8. Cache: a second identical search is served from the cache (handler called once); `MetadataCacheTests` show upsert replaces the payload, expired entries read as null, `PurgeExpiredAsync` deletes only expired rows, and 20 concurrent `SetAsync` calls on one key leave exactly one row.
9. Spacing: `RequestSpacingGate` (1 s, `FakeTimeProvider`) — three concurrent waiters: the first completes immediately, the second only after advancing 1 s, the third only after 2 s; a cancelled waiter throws `OperationCanceledException`. DI composition test (real `TimeProvider`, `RetryBaseDelay` set to 10 ms): stub primary handler answers `503` with `Retry-After: 1` then `200` → the client returns the result, the handler saw 2 requests, and ≥ 1 s elapsed between them.
10. `[LiveFact]` (`COMPILARR_LIVE_TESTS=1`): ISRC `GBUM71029604` → contains `b1a9c0e9-d987-4042-ae91-78d6a3267d69`; `GetRecordingAsync` of it → length within 355106 ± 2000; the first browse page has ≥ 100 releases.
